first.rationale: Onboarding simplification currently has the best chance to address both observed declines—completion and activation—while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Verify its adoption impact, compare activation messaging, and inspect promotional pricing for customer quality, retention, and post-discount revenue risk before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified evidence directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and supports sustainable value: completion rose 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. Activation messaging remains a credible alternative, but has a smaller retention lift. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its 18% qualified-revenue lift was paired with a 12% retention decline and failure through first renewal.
